### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the Messages streaming error-propagation change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes Messages streaming in `aiclient` so provider errors are propagated instead of allowing partial responses to appear successfully completed. **Changes:** - Add provider error events to the Messages stream event union. - Decode those events into `StreamPiece.error` for the existing consumer to throw. - Add regression tests for errors both before text and after a partial text delta. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `ts/​packages/​aiclient/​test/​providerAdapter.spec.ts` | Tests error propagation and absence of text or usage on error pieces. | | `ts/​packages/​aiclient/​src/​wireApiProvider/​messagesWireApiProvider.ts` | Converts provider error events into stream errors. | | `ts/​packages/​aiclient/​src/​wireApiProvider/​messages.types.ts` | Defines error events and includes them in the stream event union. |
Review effort: Balanced
